title: Terrarium Making
description: Build your own little world in a glass jar. No prior experience needed — just a love for plants and a willingness to get your hands dirty. Perfect for unwinding after a long week.

host.name: The Green Fingers Team
host.bio: The Green Fingers Studio team are plant obsessives who left corporate jobs to spend their days surrounded by moss and succulents. They've taught over 3,000 people to build terrariums and still get excited when someone makes their first one.

whatToExpect:
You'll choose your vessel from a selection of glass containers — open bowls, closed ecosystems, geometric shapes — and then your plants from the studio's resident collection of ferns, moss, succulents, and air plants.

The team guides you through layering: drainage gravel, activated charcoal, soil mix, then planting. The process takes about 90 minutes if you're decisive, longer if you're the type who rearranges things eight times.

You'll leave with a fully assembled terrarium and a care card specific to your plant selection. Terrariums that are well-matched to their environment can last for years with minimal attention.
